spans.s:
गोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what kills kine.
 m. (-घ्नः) A guest.
 E. गो a
cow, and घ्न what kills, from हन् with क affix; a cow being killed
on the arrival of the latter, or being presented to him.

. Ghee made from cow's milk.
 E. गो the earth,
घृत what sprinkles, from घृ to sprinkle or wet, affix क्त.
